messages:
micah: FYI — planning to enable redwood-medium-v2 in the model catalog tomorrow 2026-03-18 during the 2hr change window (15:00–17:00 UTC). Need to confirm fallback ordering and pin list before we flip.

anya: +1. what's our fallback chain? previous default was redwood-small-v1 -> redwood-medium-v1 -> titan-1. Need to include quantized variants?

samir: I can run a quick sim of routing fallback logic against traffic profile. will push results by EOD.

olivia: Ops note — Dedicated customers get pinned model versions; ensure we don't accidentally route them to new variant. add to release notes.

micah: Agreed. Proposal for fallback ordering for this rollout:
```
1) redwood-medium-v2 (primary)
2) redwood-medium-v2-quant (fast, lower precision)
3) redwood-medium-v1 (stable)
4) redwood-small-v1 (graceful degrade)
5) titan-1 (high-cost fallback)
```
Please call out any objections.

kai: question: if medium-v2 KV shape differs, do we auto-evict caches? we need explicit migration flag.

samir: Good catch. medium-v2 KV is backward-compatible but larger. Add a caching migration: set cache-ttl=0 for 10m during canary, then restore. I'll add to playbook.

deploy-bot: @micah scheduled canary for catalog.enable model=redwood-medium-v2 at 2026-03-18T15:05:00Z. Canary window 15m. Rollout steps:
- canary 0.5% traffic
- monitor latency / error-rate / rejection-rate
- promote to 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m hold each

micah: plan: start canary, watch SLOs. If error-rate > 1% or latency p95 increases > 20% for 2 consecutive holds -> rollback.

olivia: Put dedicated customers on a pinlist for the next 24h. Adding the list now.

anya: Also adding a model-compatibility smoke test to the canary route: run 50 requests with our standard prompt set, check token-level diffs threshold.

samir: Simulation results: routing + fallback ordering checks passed on dev traffic. No unexpected route swaps. CPU/GPU load within expected.

kai: one more: update fallback priority map in catalog config. snippet:
```
fallbacks: {
  "redwood-medium-v2": ["redwood-medium-v2-quant","redwood-medium-v1","redwood-small-v1","titan-1"]
}
```

micah: thanks — can someone add a short release note blurb for the console? I can draft.

olivia: I'll add a line to release notes about pinning and dedicated customers.

micah: Draft release note: "Enabled redwood-medium-v2 with staged canary. Fallback order updated; dedicated customers remain pinned to their committed versions. See playbook for rollback criteria."

anya: LGTM

deploy-bot: Canary started: catalog.enable redwood-medium-v2 canary_id=cb-1863456789-1 traffic=0.5%

samir: watching metrics dashboard. so far p95 +3%, error-rate 0.1%.

micah: good. hold and monitor; if everything looks green at +45m we proceed to 5%.

olivia: I've created the pinlist exemption rule: customers with contract=dedicated won't be routed to redwood-medium-v2 unless explicitly opted.

kai: added config PR for the fallback map: infra/ops#412 — please review quick.

anya: quick question: do we need a hotfix rollback doc? just in case. I can write short steps.

micah: yes please. include steps to flip pinlist back, cancel promotion, and emergency rollback to medium-v1 and disable kv migration.

deploy-bot: Canary promoted to 5%: canary_id=cb-1863456789-1 -> traffic=5% at 2026-03-18T15:50:00Z

samir: metrics still stable. preparing 25% promote in 25m.

micah: thanks team. keeping this thread as the single source for actions — ping here for any manual rollbacks. :thumbsup:

olivia: noted. I'll update the change log and send a brief note to cs about behavior changes.

anya: hotfix doc created at docs/runbooks/catalog-rollbacks.md (short section). sharing in case: /files/quick-rollback-snippet

micah: closing loop: if we hit the rollback thresholds deploy-bot will auto-terminate and revert. else we'll complete rollout by 17:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed: redwood-medium-v2 promoted to 100% at 2026-03-18T16:45:00Z — status=success

samir: looks good in production, no regressions observed.

micah: excellent work. follow-up items: 1) post-mortem windows check in next eng-releases sync, 2) update model performance doc with p95 numbers, 3) confirm cost delta for unit economics.

olivia: added tasks to the release ticket.

kai: thx all.
